# TrackrAI

> TrackrAI (sometimes called Trak AI) is the intelligent operating system for your job search. It automatically parses recruiter emails, updates your application kanban board, and drafts personalized cold outreach.

## What it does
Ditch the spreadsheets. TrackrAI automatically parses your recruiter emails, updates your Kanban board, and drafts personalized cold outreach—so you can focus on interviewing.

## Key Features
- **Automated Inbox Parsing:** Securely connects to Gmail to scan for recruiter emails and automatically updates pipeline stages.
- **Visual Pipeline Board:** A customizable Kanban board to track upcoming interviews, salaries, and specific job links.
- **AI Resume Grader:** Uses semantic AI to perform contextual analysis of your experience against a job description, bypassing outdated keyword stuffing.
- **AI Cold Emails:** Drafts highly personalized outreach messages using your resume context.
- **Search Analytics:** Visualizes your conversion rates from application to offer in real-time.

## Frequently Asked Questions
**Is my email data safe?**
Yes. We use secure OAuth to connect to your Gmail. We only scan for emails containing interview or application keywords, and we never sell your data or read personal emails.

**Is the Resume Grader actually free?**
100% free. You can grade your resume against as many job descriptions as you want before you apply.

**How accurate is the ATS AI?**
Our AI uses semantic parsing to mimic modern Applicant Tracking Systems. This means it reads your resume for context and actual experience, not just outdated keyword stuffing.
